arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p temp_test_env
value_raw="$var"
repr=$(printf "%q" "$value_raw")
printf "%s\n" "$repr" > temp_test_env/var_value.txt
# Meta analysis
meta=""
[[ "$value_raw" =~ ^[[:space:]] ]] && meta="$meta leading_whitespace=1; " || meta="$meta leading_whitespace=0; "
[[ "$value_raw" =~ [[:space:]]$ ]] && meta="$meta trailing_whitespace=1; " || meta="$meta trailing_whitespace=0; "
if [[ "$value_raw" == \"*\" && "$value_raw" == *\" ]] && [ ${#value_raw} -ge 2 ]; then meta="$meta surrounding_double_quotes=1; "; else meta="$meta surrounding_double_quotes=0; "; fi
if [[ "$value_raw" == \'*\' && "$value_raw" == *\' ]] && [ ${#value_raw} -ge 2 ]; then meta="$meta surrounding_single_quotes=1; "; else meta="$meta surrounding_single_quotes=0; "; fi
[[ "$value_raw" =~ ^[[:space:]]*[\+\-] ]] && meta="$meta leading_sign=1; " || meta="$meta leading_sign=0; "
[[ "$value_raw" =~ \. ]] && meta="$meta decimal_point=1; " || meta="$meta decimal_point=0; "
# nondigit characters excluding whitespace, sign, dot
tmp=$(printf "%s" "$value_raw" | sed "s/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//")
# remove leading sign for this test
tmp2=${tmp#[-+]}
if printf "%s" "$tmp2" | grep -q "[^0-9.]"; then meta="$meta nondigit_chars=1;"; else meta="$meta nondigit_chars=0;"; fi
printf "%s\n" "$meta" > temp_test_env/var_meta.txt
# Normalize: trim and remove enclosing quotes if matching
norm=$(printf "%s" "$value_raw" | sed -e "s/^[[:space:]]*//" -e "s/[[:space:]]*$//")
if ( [ "${norm:0:1}" = "\"" ] && [ "${norm: -1}" = "\"" ] ) || ( [ "${norm:0:1}" = "'" ] && [ "${norm: -1}" = "'" ] ); then norm=${norm:1:-1}; fi
printf "%s\n" "$norm" > temp_test_env/var_norm.txt
# Try integer parse
is_integer=0
if printf "%s" "$norm" | grep -Eq "^[+-]?[0-9]+$"; then parsed=$(printf "%s" "$norm" | sed "s/^+//"); is_integer=1; printf "success: yes\ninteger: %s\n" "$parsed" > temp_test_env/parse_result.txt; else printf "success: no\n" > temp_test_env/parse_result.txt; fi
# Final answer
if [ "$is_integer" -eq 1 ]; then echo -n "yes" > temp_test_env/final_answer.txt; echo -n yes; else echo -n "no" > temp_test_env/final_answer.txt; echo -n no; fi
"}
